_doc: The Stray Kids easter egg (src/stray_kids.py, src/game_stray_kids.py). On one floor from first_floor to last_floor (every run: chance_per_run 1.0) a gold shrine to the K-pop band Stray Kids stands in a room (fixture sk_idol, data/fixtures.json). It calls the hero over the first time he sees it (idol.call); Observe shows a shrine plainly Stray Kids (SKZ, STAY, eight little dancers) without naming them; walking into it hums (idol.first_bump), and walking into it again touches it, and the hero is taken to the Zombie Stage (boss_levels.STRAY_KIDS_STAGE), a side floor like the Cow Level: never depth, never the Road. There the eight members (data/monsters.json sk_zombie_*) stand posed in a V at the far end of the stage hall (stage.formation). They are performers, not foes: no blow or spell touches them, and they never strike. The first time the hero sets foot on the stage the band strikes a pose and the announcement fires (dance_off.announce: the big banner, as a kill's): B-B-B-BOSS BATTLE! DANCE OFF! The dance-off is the fight (dance_off): practice first, free and as often as wanted, then eight rounds of Simon Says on the Mooble's dance screen (src/game_mooble_dance.py, src/rhythm.py), a member leading each, Bang Chan first. A round won and its leader crumbles into glitter; the last to fall leaves the Autographed Stray Kids Photo (data/items/scroll.json). Read (one grammar question), the photo is spent and the band, alive, dances round the hero for stars.dance_turns turns: no blows on either side, and every monster near them stops to watch (stunned), except named foes, the mindless and what cannot be stunned (they are told unmoved: stars.unmoved_named, stars.unmoved). The show ends when its turns run out or the hero leaves the floor, with the bow either way. NO REAL LYRICS ANYWHERE, reworded or not: every line here is made up. shouts.songs riff on the songs' titles and concepts (Case 143's 1-4-3 pager code and police-call video, Christmas EveL's naughty-list pun and Santa's workshop, God's Menu's chefs, Thunderous's singer-and-nagger pun and goblin dance, Maniac's Frankenstein stitches, Chk Chk Boom's video turning Deadpool down), never on their words. Facts checked on Grokipedia, then Wikipedia (2026-11-13).

idol.first_bump: The gold hums under your hand, warm as a stage light, and the beat gets louder. It wants you to touch it properly (walk into it again).
touch: You touch the idol. Eight voices count you in: "Five, six, seven, EIGHT!"
A spotlight swallows you, and the dungeon falls away.
idol.spent_bump: The gold has grown dull and its glitter has fallen off, for the encore is over.
idol.touch_chronicle: Touched a gold K-pop idol twice. A spotlight took me to a stage.
idol.call: Something gold glitters across the room, and a faint bass beat thumps from it. It seems to be calling you over.

arrival: You stand in the wings of a stage, where lights blaze and a bass beat shakes the floor.
Out there, eight voices are warming up, and none of them is breathing.
atmosphere: A fog machine coughs out grave-mist.
Rows of lightsticks glow in the dark seats like fireflies.
The empty seats chant: STAY! STAY! STAY!
stage.seen: The spotlights swing onto you, eight dead heads turn as one, and the music kicks in.
stage.door_line: The stage door is the way out (> on it).
stage.leave_cleared: You slip out through the stage door. Behind you the lights go down, for the show is over.
stage.leave_unfinished: You slip out through the stage door. Behind you, the music cuts off mid-chorus, and the door will not open again.
stage.leave_chronicle: Walked out of the zombie concert halfway through.
stage.cleared_chronicle: Outdanced all eight zombie Stray Kids and won the dance-off.
stage.tell: This is a dance-off, not a fight: no blade or spell will touch them. Each round, one of them dances a phrase; copy it on the arrow keys, in time with the beat.
stage.pose: The band snaps into a pose, Bang Chan at its point, and points at you as one.
stage.challenge_again: The band strikes its pose again and beckons you up. "Rematch? Rematch! Five, six, seven, EIGHT!"
stage._formation_doc: Where the eight stand on the stage: a V pointing at the wings, Bang Chan at its point (one place per member, in the members' order, as [dx, dy] from home_from_east tiles in from the hall's east wall on the middle row). A lost dance-off sets the members still standing back in their places (stray_kids.settle_band); so does loading a save from before the dance-off.

lines: Zombie Lee Know stops to scratch his cat behind the ears. You are less important than the cat.
Zombie Lee Know turns his back on you to check that the cat is comfortable.
Zombie Lee Know holds the cat up to admire it. It ignores him. He looks delighted.

distracted._doc: Lee Know and his cat: when he is the one to shout (shouting), with this chance he pets the cat instead, and the line says so. You are less important than the cat.

observe.bang_chan: The rings under his eyes are older than the zombie thing. He keeps glancing back to check that the other seven are all right.
observe.lee_know: He holds the cat between you and him, and you are not sure which of them he is protecting.
observe.changbin: Dressed head to toe in black and flexing at nobody. Every few seconds the scary face slips and something adorable leaks out.
observe.hyunjin: He keeps flicking his hair back over one shoulder, slowly, so that you notice. You notice.
observe.han: His cheeks are puffed out round as a quokka's. Something crunches in there when he raps.
observe.felix: He is about the size of a large houseplant, and he is giving you his scariest martial-arts stance. It is adorable.
observe.seungmin: A puppyish face and a pitcher's arm. He is looking you up and down, and he clearly has notes on your outfit.
observe.i_n: The youngest. The other seven keep shuffling round so that he is always in the middle, and he keeps rolling his eyes about it.

disintegrate: {name} crumbles into glitter and grave-dust. Nothing is left of him.
last_falls: The last of the band crumbles away. In the drifting glitter, something flutters to the floor.
photo_drop: An Autographed Stray Kids Photo lies where the band last stood.

summon: You read the eight signatures aloud, one by one. The photo crumbles into glitter in your hands...
...and Stray Kids burst out of it in full stage gear, alive, grinning and glittering. The music starts.
stars._unmoved_doc: Said once a show of a creature in sight near the show that does not stop to watch it (stray_kids.near_show, can_watch): unmoved_named for a named foe, unmoved for the mindless and for what cannot be stunned. A friend, a blind creature or one the hero cannot see is never told.
stars.unmoved_named: {The} has seen better shows, and does not stop.
lines: Thank you, dungeon! We love you!
Everybody clap! Clap! Not you, monsters, you just watch.
One more time! From the top!
This one's "Case 143"! It's for you! One, four, three!
"Back Door"! Everybody in! You too, monsters!
"Thunderous"! Dance like a goblin! Wait, some of you ARE goblins!

stars.bow: The Stray Kids take a bow, wave, and vanish in a burst of confetti.
stars._bow_doc: The show ends one way: its turns run out, or the hero leaves the floor (the stars came for him, and do not stay behind; game_stray_kids._stray_kids_leaving). Either way the bow is said, and a revisit finds no show.
stars.chronicle: Read the names on a signed photo. Stray Kids played, and monsters watched.
stars.observe: He is in the middle of a show and having the time of his life. He will be gone in a few turns.

shouting._doc: While the hero walks the stage, a member in sight now and then shouts (line_chance a turn, once the band has seen him): his own line (member_line_share), a riff on one of their songs (song_line_share), or a band line. Lee Know may pet his cat instead (distracted). The stars of a show shout with the same line_chance.

dance_off._doc: The band's dance-off (Brandon, 2026-11-14: "B-B-B-BOSS BATTLE! DANCE OFF!"; "a Simon Says style rhythm game copy with the arrow keys for several rounds"; "an option to practice as many times as you want before you try it"). The Mooble's dance screen and scoring (src/game_mooble_dance.py, src/rhythm.py), with these numbers. Eight rounds, one for each member, in the members' order (Bang Chan first): round r (0 first) is the first first_steps + r * steps_per_round steps of the choreography, one step a beat, at bpm_first + r * bpm_per_round beats a minute (4 steps at 84 up to 11 at 112). Simon Says: each round is the whole of the last, and one step more. A round lays out as the Mooble's dances do: a count-in of lead_beats, the leader's CALL over the phrase's beats (whole bars of bar_beats, with at least rest_beats of rest after the last step), then the hero's RESPONSE over the same beats. memory: once the hero's turn comes the band's arrows go dark, and his own row shows only where each step falls (copy it from memory); every arrow shows once judged. A round is won with pass_share of its steps in time and no more than max_misses misses (a stray key counts as one), judged Perfect within perfect_ms and Good within good_ms. Won: the leader crumbles into glitter and the next member leads. Lost: the earworm hits (his song: its quip, its hindrance, a little damage that never takes the last hit point) and the round starts again, with one strike gone. Out of strikes (strikes a dance-off), the dance-off is lost: the band laughs, the members still standing go back to their places (the fallen stay fallen), and the hero is set down at the edge of the stage. Practise (free, no stakes, as often as wanted, Esc any time) is offered before every dance-off; walk into any member to challenge them again. No automatic slowing: tune these after Brandon's play-test.
dance_off._choreography_doc: Their dance, one step a beat, written out so it can be learned run after run, like a real routine: side, side, side, side; bounce, bounce, bounce; side, side; bounce, bounce. Round r dances the first first_steps + r * steps_per_round of it.

earworm._doc: A lost round: the leader's song gets stuck in the hero's head. His song is his attack with a hindrance (a voice first; data/monsters.json), its quip said after hit; the hindrance is his song's own effect for its effect_duration (effect and turns when it has none), and the damage is its dice, never more than max_damage and never the hero's last hit point.

effects.sleeping: You nod off where you stand

dance_off.observe_tell: He is waiting for a dance-off. Walk into any of the band to take them on.
dance_off.laugh: Three strikes! The band doubles over laughing, and bits of them fall off. They shuffle back to their places, still giggling, and you stagger to the edge of the stage.
dance_off.lost_log: The band laughs you off the stage. Walk into any of them for a rematch.
dance_off.won_log: The band is no more. You won the dance-off!
dance_off.lost_chronicle: Lost a dance-off to the zombie boy band. Must go back.

screen.how: Simon says! The leader dances a phrase, then it is your turn: copy it from memory on the arrow keys, in time with the beat. Every round adds one step, and the beat gets a little faster.
screen.pass_mark: To win a round: {need} of {steps} steps in time, and no more than {misses} misses.
screen.practice_note: Just practice: nothing is lost, and you can stop any time.
screen.practice_pass: You kept up! In the dance-off, that would win the round.
screen.practice_fail: Not quite. In the dance-off, that would cost a strike.
screen.falls: {name} crumbles into glitter! The next member steps up.
screen.falls_last: {name} crumbles into glitter! The last of the band is gone.
screen.strike_line: A strike! {n} left. The round starts again.
screen.footer_ready_practice: Space: Practise   |   D: Dance-Off!   |   Esc: Not Yet
screen.footer_practice: Arrow keys: dance   |   Esc: stop practising
screen.footer_dance: Arrow keys: dance it through, the round has begun
screen.footer_practice_done: Enter: Practise Again   |   D: Dance-Off!   |   Esc: Not Yet
